Definition: from G303 and a compound of the base of G2226 and G4442; to re-enkindle:--stir up.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells Timothy to stir up the gift of God that is in him by the laying on of his hands. The picture is a fire banked low and blown back into flame, a gift that needs tending rather than a new gift altogether.
TheologicalSignificance: A single picture of a fire rekindled holds no doctrine of its own; its encouragement is Paul's, that Timothy's gift was still there, waiting to be stirred.
